title: EmbrAIon Project Source Registry
description: Optional registry of the stable source IDs a project uses: role, write policy, documentation, and an optional raised data class. Machine-local paths never belong here.

role.description: canonical-code: the project's own authoritative code. shared-library: a first-party library several projects reuse. reference: a read-only example or earlier implementation. external-upstream: a vendor or third-party source the project does not own. application-data: runtime or user data.

write.description: read-only: agents read it and never write it. workspace-write: agents may write it in an authorized task. forbidden: agents neither write it nor treat it as writable under any task.

doc.description: Repository-relative path of the documentation that governs this source. The file must exist.

data-class.description: May only raise the class declared for this ID in privacy.sources (or the privacy default class when privacy.sources is not declared).
